answer.original_source: NN, Inc. announcement (late June 2026), reported by finance.yahoo.com on 2026-07-01; the original_day is not stated
answer.new_information: NN, Inc. (ticker NNBR, not a covered NVDA name) would add 47 machine centers at its Wuxi, China plant for liquid cooling for NVIDIA AI racks, with 100% of the new capacity said to be pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards. It targets US$80–US$90 million of accretive new business in 2026. This is the company's own statement, with no independent verification of the pre-sold claim or the revenue target. The Russell Microcap Value Index removal in late June 2026 is a reported fact with no stated source beyond finance.yahoo.com. The 2028 revenue and earnings figures are a third-party narrative (US$485.5m / US$47.9m) and an unnamed analyst rumour (US$489.5m / US$48.3m), with no mapping to NVDA periods or definitions. The article's valuation claims (fair value, upside) and its promotional links are not usable data.
